items.description: The boundary layer under app/routes/ does not import the database session, asserted by static import inspection
The service layer under app/services/ contains no ORM or session imports, asserted by static import inspection
The boundary layer under app/routes/ contains no ORM or session imports (distinct from the DB-session layering check), asserted by static import inspection
DATABASE_URL is read from the environment and no hardcoded connection string appears in the source, asserted by config inspection
The app/routes boundary handlers return JSON responses and contain no server-side HTML template rendering, asserted by route inspection
The Alembic migration for stock_records downgrades and re-upgrades in a single step under @pytest.mark.migration without downgrading to base, verified on the real branch
Rows seeded with a per-run-unique sku before the stock_records migration survive the upgrade with their filed values intact, scoped to the test's own seeded rows
App renders the stock-filing form page at the /stock/file route when navigated to via MemoryRouter initialEntries=["/stock/file"]
The stock-filing form at /stock/file renders the SKU input field with data-testid="sku-input"
The stock-filing form at /stock/file renders the location input field with data-testid="location-input"
The stock-filing form at /stock/file renders the quantity input field with data-testid="quantity-input"
The stock-filing form at /stock/file renders the inventory_code input field with data-testid="inventory-code-input"
A POST to the stock API with a valid uuid-suffixed SKU, location, quantity, and inventory_code returns a success response confirming the record is durably saved
A POST to the stock API that omits a required field returns a 4xx response whose body names the offending field
A direct insert into stock_records omitting a NOT NULL column (sku, location, inventory_code, or quantity) is rejected by the database on the real branch
A write attempting quantity below zero is rejected by the PI3 DB CHECK constraint with no row stored, verified on the real branch with a per-run-unique sku
The service layer rejects a write that would store a negative quantity before it reaches the repository, verified on the real branch
App renders the stock-record display page at the /stock/record route when navigated to via MemoryRouter initialEntries=["/stock/record"]
The stock-record display at /stock/record shows the filed quantity value in an element with data-testid="record-quantity"
The stock-record display at /stock/record shows the filed inventory_code value in an element with data-testid="record-inventory-code"
A GET to the stock API for a previously filed uuid-suffixed SKU and location returns exactly the quantity and inventory_code that were submitted in the original POST
Filing stock twice for the same uuid-suffixed (sku, location) pair on the real branch leaves exactly one stored row, enforced by the PI1 composite unique constraint
A concurrent repeat file for the same uuid-suffixed (sku, location) pair persists exactly one row because the read-then-upsert runs in a single transaction (PI4), verified on the real branch
Re-filing an existing uuid-suffixed (sku, location) row leaves created_at unchanged from its original value while the row is updated in place, verified on the real branch
App at /stock/file shows a success indicator (data-testid="submit-success") after a second filing for the same uuid-suffixed SKU and location pair
App at /stock/file renders no element with data-testid="submit-error" after a second filing for the same uuid-suffixed SKU and location pair
A second POST to the stock API for the same uuid-suffixed SKU and location pair results in exactly one record for that pair in the store
